description: Full Harness, Impeccable, design-taste-frontend, and avoid-ai-writing hooks. Install at .codex/hooks.json in a trusted target project and review them in Codex before use.

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process'),g='.codex/skills/avoid-ai-writing/bin/avoid-ai-writing-gate.js';function run(raw){let d={};try{const t=(raw.charCodeAt(0)===65279?raw.slice(1):raw).trim();if(t)d=JSON.parse(t);}catch(e){}if(d&&(d.stop_hook_active||d.continuationActive))process.exit(0);const b=(d&&typeof d.cwd==='string'&&d.cwd)?d.cwd:process.cwd();const top=cp.spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],{cwd:b,encoding:'utf8'});if(top.status===0&&top.stdout.trim()){}else{process.exit(0);}const root=path.resolve(top.stdout.trim()),gate=fs.existsSync(path.join(root,g))?path.join(root,g):path.resolve(b,g);if(fs.existsSync(gate)===false)process.exit(0);const st=cp.spawnSync('git',['-c','core.quotepath=false','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],{cwd:root,encoding:'utf8'});if(st.status===0){}else{process.exit(0);}const files=st.stdout.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map(l=>l.replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(13),'').slice(3).split(' -> ').pop().trim().replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34),'')).filter(p=>{const n=p.split(path.sep).join('/'),lo=n.toLowerCase();return p&&(lo.endsWith('.md')||lo.endsWith('.mdx'))&&['.agents','.codex','.claude'].some(x=>n.startsWith(x+'/'))===false&&fs.existsSync(path.join(root,p));});if(files.length===0)process.exit(0);const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[gate,'--json','--context','technical','--source-mode','rendered-markdown','--threshold','6','--',...files],{cwd:root,encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status===0)process.exit(0);let reason=(r.stderr||r.stdout||'avoid-ai-writing gate failed').trim();try{const j=JSON.parse(r.stdout);const bad=(j.files||[]).filter(x=>x.pass===false).map(x=>x.path+' ('+x.findings+' findings: '+(x.types||[]).join(', ')+')');if(bad.length)reason='avoid-ai-writing failed threshold '+j.threshold+': '+bad.join('; ')+' — rewrite AI-ism prose before finishing.';}catch(e){}const dec=('--hook codex').endsWith('antigravity')?'continue':'block';process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:dec,reason})+String.fromCharCode(10));process.exit(0);}if(process.stdin.isTTY){run('');}else{let raw='',done=false;const fin=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;clearTimeout(tm);try{process.stdin.pause();process.stdin.destroy();}catch(e){}run(raw);};const tm=setTimeout(fin,500);process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');process.stdin.on('data',c=>{raw+=c;if(raw.length>1048576)fin();});process.stdin.on('end',fin);process.stdin.on('error',fin);}"
